mechanism_narrative: A sustained federal funds rate below 0.5% indicates an accommodative monetary policy stance that reduces discount rates for equity valuation, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in >55% of periods when FEDFUNDS < 0.5%, or Rank IC falls below 0.02 in any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A 1-month unemployment rate increase exceeding 0.2 percentage points above 6.7% signals deteriorating labor market conditions, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in >55% of triggered instances, or Rank IC falls below 0.02 in any 1-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous expansion in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) above their 1-year moving averages indicates robust consumer demand, amplifying corporate earnings growth and driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are negative in >55% of periods where both HOUST and RSAFS exceed 1-year moving averages, or Rank IC for interaction term falls below 0.02 in any 2-year window.

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion regime, a deceleration in industrial production (INDPRO) below its 6-month moving average signals weakening economic momentum, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in >55% of instances during late-cycle expansion with INDPRO deceleration, or Rank IC falls below 0.02 in any 2-year window.

mechanism_narrative: A year-over-year Consumer Price Index increase above 2.5% signals accelerating inflation, prompting Federal Reserve monetary tightening that depresses equity valuations and produces negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in >55% of periods when CPIAUCSL YoY > 2.5%, or Rank IC falls below 0.02 in any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Sustained non-farm payrolls growth above 150,000 per month indicates a strengthening labor market, supporting consumer spending and corporate earnings to produce positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are negative in >55% of months with PAYEMS growth > 150,000, or Rank IC falls below 0.02 in any 1-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in housing starts (HOUST) below 800,000 annualized units signals weakening consumer demand for housing, preceding broader economic slowdown and producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in >55% of instances when HOUST < 800.0, or Rank IC falls below 0.02 in any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent expansion in industrial production (INDPRO) and real GDP (GDPC1) above their 1-year moving averages indicates robust economic supply capacity, supporting corporate profitability and driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in >55% of periods where both INDPRO and GDPC1 exceed 1-year moving averages, or Rank IC for interaction term falls below 0.02 in any 2-year rolling window.
